title: sphaerostigma andinum var. hilgardii
intro: Sphaerostigma andinum var. hilgardii, commonly known as Hilgard's sphaerostigma, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. It is used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory infections, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hilgard's sphaerostigma include reducing fever and alleviating symptoms associated with colds and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
